title: A sports feast: What to watch this Thanksgiving weekend

body_markdown:
Thanksgiving is all about family, great food, and, of course, a full day of sports from the best seat in the house—your couch! And this year, the action starts early, so there’s no need to wait until Thanksgiving Day to start watching.


#### **Thanksgiving Eve slate**


The **NFL’s** week 12 coverage kicks off on ***Netflix*** at **8 p.m. ET** Wednesday, Nov. 25, when **the Green Bay Packers** visit the **Los Angeles Rams** on Wednesday, November 25. The matchup adds even more excitement to “Thanksgiving Eve,” giving families a chance to settle in for football the day before the turkey hits the table. And the entertainment doesn’t stop at halftime, when renowned Irish rock band U2 takes the stage.


There’s plenty more Wednesday, too. The **NBA** has a full slate of games, including Emirates NBA Cup action, while **college basketball’s** Thanksgiving-week tournaments give fans even more to choose from.


#### **Thanksgiving action**


Then comes the main course— **three NFL games** on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26.


- The **Chicago Bears** visit the **Detroit Lions** at **1 p.m. ET** ( ***CBS*** and ***Paramount+*** )
- The **Philadelphia Eagles** visit the **Dallas Cowboys** at **4:30 p.m. ET** ( ***FOX*** and ***FOX One*** )
- The holiday wraps up with the **Kansas City Chiefs** visiting the **Buffalo Bills** at **8:20 p.m. ET** ( ***NBC*** and ***Peacock*** )


#### **Black Friday games**


And the leftovers come with even more football. On Black Friday, Nov. 27, the **Denver Broncos** visit the **Pittsburgh Steelers** at **3 p.m. ET** on ***Prime Video*** . The **NHL** also returns with a packed Black Friday schedule, giving hockey fans games throughout the afternoon and evening.

So, gather the family, grab the remote, and fill your plate. From Thanksgiving Eve through Black Friday, there’s plenty of sports action to enjoy together.
